definitions.explanation: A watercraft used for transportation on water. Includes small boats and large ships.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}で{島|しま}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'm going to the island by boat.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{船|ふね}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: I can see a big ship.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}に{乗|の}ると、{酔|よ}います。
examples.english: I get seasick when I ride a boat.
examples.notes: 酔う means to get drunk/sick from motion

notes: {船|ふね} can refer to any size of watercraft. {船酔|ふなよ}い is 'seasickness'. For larger ships, the reading can be {船|せん} in compounds like {客船|きゃくせん} (passenger ship). {港|みなと} means 'port/harbor'.
